save_participant_id_message: Fadlan kaydi aqoonsigan. Waxaad u baahan doontaa haddii aad rabto inaad wareysiga sii wadato mar dambe.
consent_agreement: Markaad gujiso “Waan oggolahay”, waxaad xaqiijinaysaa inaad akhriday oo fahantay macluumaadka kore isla markaana aad oggolaatay ka qaybgalka cilmi-baaristan.
participant_type_required: Fadlan dooro “Waxaan ahay ka-qaybgale cusub” ama “Hore ayaan uga qaybgalay”.
